title: Are Generics and Negativity about Social Groups Common on Social Media? – A Comparative Analysis of Twitter (X) Data
reasoning: The paper uses language models (BERT and DistilBERT) to analyze the use of linguistic generics and stereotypes about social groups on Twitter. While it discusses social norms and moral outrage, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious faith, spiritual traditions, or specific ethical/moral frameworks; it is an empirical study in the fields of social philosophy and linguistics.
